key_insight: VideoGPA distills 3D geometry priors from a pre-trained geometry foundation model into video diffusion models via self-supervised alignment, enabling much stronger multi-view and temporal structural consistency in generated videos with little extra data.
problem_solved: Video diffusion models often produce object deformation and spatial drift because standard denoising objectives do not explicitly enforce geometric coherence across frames and views.
method: Use a geometry foundation model to extract geometric cues (e.g., depth, normals, correspondences) from frames without extra manual labels.

Distill those cues into the video denoiser with self-supervised geometric-consistency losses (view-consistency and correspondence-aware penalties) that align generation behavior with geometry preferences.
Keep the approach data-efficient and plug-and-play so existing VDMs can be enhanced to produce 3D-consistent video outputs.
impact: Improves realism and structural stability of generated videos, reducing artifacts like shape collapse and spatial drift—beneficial for content creation, video editing, and downstream 3D-aware applications.
